## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `AccessControl`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `access-control-2`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **AccessControl**.

## Step 2: Give a team access to everything

1. <!-- manual: Go to Access control in the organization sidebar. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open the Groups tab and click + Create Group. Enter a name (e.g. Platform Team) and click Create. -->
3. <!-- manual: Open the new group. In the Users tab, click + Add Users and select the team members. -->
4. <!-- manual: Switch to the Roles tab and click + Add Roles. -->
5. <!-- manual: Select the desired role (e.g. Admin), leave All Environments selected, and click Add. -->

## Step 3: Give a team access to one project only

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the project and open Access control in the project sidebar. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open the Roles tab and click the role you want to assign (e.g. Developer). -->
3. On the **Manage Role** page, select **+ Add Group**.
4. <!-- manual: Select the group, leave All Environments selected, and click Assign. -->

## Step 4: Give a team read-only access to production

1. <!-- manual: Go to the organization Access control and open the Roles tab. -->
2. <!-- manual: Click the Viewer role (or create a custom read-only role). -->
3. In the **Groups** tab, select **+ Add Groups**.
4. <!-- manual: Select the group, choose Selected Environments, pick prod, and click Assign. -->

## Step 5: Grant a developer access to a single integration

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the integration and open Access control in the integration sidebar. -->
2. <!-- manual: Open the Roles tab and click the target role (e.g. Developer). -->
3. Select **+ Add Group**, select the group, choose environments.
4. Select **Assign**.

## Step 6: Create a custom role

1. <!-- manual: Go to the organization Access control and open the Roles tab. -->
2. Select **+ Create Role**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a Role Name and an optional Description. -->
4. <!-- manual: Expand the permission categories and check the permissions you need (see [Permissions](#permissions) for the full list). -->
5. Select **Create**.
